newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market seesaw to end up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market seesaw to end up.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates fluctuated on Monday before ending higher amid a shortage of funds, and are likely to open at similar levels on Tuesday, dealers said.

The overnight market opened with bids at 12 percent and offers at 18 percent, one dealer said. The gap anrrowed down and initial deals were seen at 16 percent while heavy amounts changed hands at 13 percent.
The closing hours saw the rates surging to as high as 20 percent as shortage of funds became evident, he said.
